title: Fideon canonical schema - bopgl (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for bopgl, businessowners liability (L1 code bopgl), composing common_model.json 1.4.0 by $ref: the envelope plus the locations and buildings blocks. Built from the 13 single-LOB documents of the source-data bopgl folder (5 folders, read in place): the 8 with a native text layer (coterie 6, Leatherstocking 2) print the whole businessowners declarations, Section I property beside Section II liability, so the line's coverage codes name both; the other 5 are page images under an OCR text layer (4 agency-system prints and one coterie policy). Every field of the pre-SPEC_21 bopgl.json (bopgl.crosswalk.yaml). Package documents (bopgl_boppr) are not read for this schema. No LOB block. 2.2.0 adds the G1/bop review: the two businessowners declarations of that folder (Utica First, NYCM) were read for coverage names and field captions.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 Phase 2 schema (10 October 2026), built from 8 native seed documents of 2 carriers; replaces the pre-SPEC_21 bopgl.json (_common-shaped). Draft for the project owner's approval; the seed golds drafted against it are DRAFT, pending reviewer sign-off. 2.1.0 (23 October 2026, additive, DECISIONS row 114/115): composes common model 1.4.0; adds Section I coverage codes that businessowners declarations print and the line lacked (collapse, glass expense, lease assessment, theft damage to building, spoilage, utility services, water damage, the two percentage increases), cross-copies printed row names between bopgl and boppr, and four field captions. No path, code or alias is removed or renamed, so the 2.0.0 golds, varmaps and readers keep working; each seed's review stamp is for the seed reviewer to renew. 2.2.0 (25 October 2026, additive, G1/bop folder): coverage-code names printed by the Utica First Businessowners Special Policy (with its Maximizer package endorsement) and the NYCM BP 00 03 declarations become aliases of the existing codes, ten concepts no code covered get a code on both lines, bopgl gets the counterparts of fifteen boppr codes, and distinctive field captions are added. No path, code or alias is removed or renamed, so the 2.1.0 golds, varmaps and readers keep working. 2.3.0 (26 October 2026, additive): coverage-code names and codes for the coverage rows printed by the G1 scanned and hybrid seed documents (change request approved by the project owner). No path, code or alias is removed or renamed.

recurring_wording_review.corpus: POLICIES-FINAL-V3, original documents, read locally only
recurring_wording_review.rule: a line is kept only when it prints in 5 or more different documents of 2 or more carrier folders, has no digit run of 4 or more, and every word is itself used in 10 or more carrier folders; counts and codes only, no page text or value is stored

carriers: New York Central Mutual Fire Insurance Company
g1_bop_review.rule: a coverage name is added when a businessowners declarations in the folder prints it as a coverage row; labels and codes only, no page text or value is stored

fideon:lob_block: None. Every concept the seeds print has a home in the envelope or a common-model building block (SPEC_21 4.2.4). Section I property rows a businessowners declarations prints beside its liability are coverages of this line under BOPGL_ codes; the business liability rows use BOPGL_ codes. The common model 1.3.0 releases the shared liability codes CR-BOPGL-01 asked for (X_BI_PD_LIABILITY, X_PRODUCTS_COMPLETED_OPS, X_DAMAGE_TO_PREMISES_RENTED, X_PERSONAL_ADVERTISING_INJURY); the rename to them is a major version of the line (CHANGE_REQUESTS_bopgl.md CR-BOPGL-01). bopgl and boppr print the same Section I property beside Section II liability: every row both lines print has a counterpart code on the other line (the `counterpart` key of the coverage-code file) and the same printed names.
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-4 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules (the claims-made rule left out: a businessowners liability declarations is occurrence-based and prints no retroactive date). Rule 5: an each-occurrence liability limit never exceeds its aggregate. No premium-sum rule: the coterie declarations print one policy premium (taxes, surcharges and fees included) and no coverage premiums. A rule whose values a document does not print is not evaluated.
